subject: Reserved GPU pool sizing & discount approval for Vertex Health
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vertexhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@vertexhealth.com
Cc: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@vertexhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-01T09:17:00Z
Subject: Sizing questions + competitive match (Vertex Health)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency/throughput looked promising. Before we loop in Procurement, a couple of quick follow-ups on the Dedicated offering:

- We expect up to ~180 concurrent user sessions at peak, translating to an average of ~140 qps (short bursts to 300 qps for 10-30s).
- Primary workload is generation-heavy (long-form clinical summarization) with median seq len ~512; KV cache reuse should help, but we want a throughput guarantee for peak windows.

Procurement asked whether Redwood can: (1) provide a committed reserved pool sized for our peak (we're thinking 8x A100 equivalent), (2) offer a competitive match to the public vendor we have (they quoted a 20% discount on list for a 12-month commit), and (3) provide an onboarding/credits line ($25k) to cover migration work.

Can you confirm whether those commitments / credits are feasible and what the SLA/throughput guarantees would look like for the pool you propose? If helpful, I can share a rough token/day estimate.

Best,
Liam
Director of Platform Integrations
Vertex Health

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Sizing questions + competitive match (Vertex Health)

Hi Liam — great to hear. Appreciate the numbers. Short answers up front: yes on a reserved pool model, and we can get close on the discount but will need an internal approval for a 20% match plus a modest onboarding credit.

Here's what I recommend as a baseline proposal (subject to final approvals):
- Reserved pool: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (auto-burst to 9 for short windows)
- Throughput: designed to cover sustained 140 qps with headroom to handle 300 qps bursts for up to 30s with automatic scaling policies and pre-warmed KV caches
- Pricing: standard 12-month reserved commit at list, with a proposed introductory discount of 15% (can escalate for strategic match)
- Onboarding credit: asking for $25k but needs exec sign-off

I've attached a quick estimates workbook with cost/throughput tradeoffs. Marcus (cc) — can you weigh in on how much credit we can approve from ops vs. needs VP OK?

Next step: if procurement is comfortable, let's get the commits and token/day numbers and I'll open a formal deal in HubSpot.

Thanks,
Naomi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-05-04T08:22:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Sizing questions + competitive match — internal (approval request)

Naomi / Karthik,

Forwarding Liam's thread — quick internal note: Vertex is strategic in the digital health vertical (good reference for our healthcare creds) and the procurement team is explicitly asking for a 20% competitive match plus a $25k onboarding credit.

Numbers I ran based on Naomi's suggested 8x A100 pool:
- ARR at list: $1,200,000 (12-mo reserved)
- Revenue impact at 15% discount: ~$180k annual reduction
- Revenue impact at 20% discount: ~$240k annual reduction
- One-time onboarding credit: $25k (absorbed by RevOps if approved)

Recommendation: Approve up to $20k one-time credit from central promotions budget and an 18% discount (conditional on signed 12-month commit and milestone-based SLA acceptance). Anything beyond that should go to the exec pricing committee.

If we want to make a case for the 20% match, we'll need a short exec note (why Vertex matters: referenceable customer, potential 2x expansion within 18 months, marketplace listing opportunity). Naomi, can you draft a 2-paragraph business case if the buyer pushes back?

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus. Short business case below for execs (will send to you both if we need to escalate):

Vertex is evaluating Redwood for a mission-critical clinical summarization flow that will be customer-facing across multiple hospital systems. They are referenceable in healthcare, have funding into Series C, and expect to expand usage (double) with additional models in 12–18 months. If we win this commit they become a high-value reference and a candidate for a marketplace feature integration.

Buyer countered asking explicitly for a 20% discount and $25k onboarding credit. They're prepared to sign a 12-month reserved commit if we meet those commercial points. I proposed an 18% discount + $20k onboarding credit as a middle ground while we request exec approval for the remaining $5k and the extra 2% discount.

Attached is the estimates workbook and the initial token/day numbers Liam shared. If Karthik can sign off on the $20k / 18% today, I can lock the deal and get legal on the initial MSA redline. If not, I will escalate with the two-paragraph note.

—Naomi
